# US Flooring & Molding Inc.

> Established flooring store and professional flooring installation company serving Burbank and the greater Los Angeles area. We provide flooring materials, molding, baseboards, professional installation, and assistance selecting the right flooring for residential and commercial properties.

## Products and Services

US Flooring & Molding Inc. provides flooring products and professional services for residential and commercial properties.

Primary offerings include:

- Hardwood flooring
- Laminate flooring

- Flooring installation
- Molding and baseboard installation
- Flooring product selection
- Residential flooring
- Commercial flooring
- Free flooring estimates
